rules.eligible: players with at least 2 played games
rules.reps: min(sizes.reps, games); rep r hides the game with the r-th smallest hide key; one game per evaluation
rules.subsets: test_sample players, rep 0 only: per_stratum takes the first n of each stratum; proportional splits n over the strata by the largest remainder of n * W_s and takes the first of each
rules.test_pool: every other eligible player; W_s = counts.test_pool[s] / counts.test_pool.all
rules.test_sample: the first sizes.test_sample[s] test-pool players of each stratum (null: all of them)
rules.user_key: sha256(salt + ':user:' + player_id), smallest first; every player list is in this order
